headline: NVDA keeps the same visible read under standard effort: 02 stays first, 03 still matters, and 00 remains control-only.
stable_findings: 02 remains the strongest default lane on the fixed NVDA pair.
03 still changes the lead story relative to 02 while holding the tagged packet fixed.
00 still functions as a readable control on the same tagged substrate.
weakened_under_standard: The standard wave is still a bounded control packet, so the claim stays narrower than a broader benchmark-style comparison.
03 still trails 02 as the default lane, so reduced reasoning does not reverse the ordering.
00 stays noncanonical and ad hoc, so it still cannot support a structured-lane claim.

lane_robustness.02: 02 remains the strongest default lane on the fixed NVDA pair.
lane_robustness.03: 03 still changes the lead story relative to 02 while holding the tagged packet fixed.
lane_robustness.00: 00 still functions as a readable control on the same tagged substrate. 00 stays noncanonical and ad hoc, so it still cannot support a structured-lane claim.

integrity_note: NVDA shows no capture-integrity failure on the visible standard lanes.
caveat: On this fixed NVDA pair, protocol value still appears visible under standard thinking, but the claim remains a bounded pilot finding rather than a benchmark.
